bio:
Gallagher Security is a global leader in integrated technology solutions that help organizations around the world protect, secure, and manage people and assets. Our award-winning solutions are trusted by government, defense, commercial, industrial, healthcare, transportation, mining, and educational organizations in 140 countries.

We design and manufacture a comprehensive suite of security software and hardware - including integrated access control, intruder alarm, and perimeter solutions - all on site at our global headquarters. The intelligent technology can be scaled and customized to deliver business efficiencies across simple, enterprise, and high security sites.

Trusted by over 20,000 security customers worldwide, Gallagher solutions are used to simplify life on campus within the education sector, keep staff and patients safe in healthcare, ensure the highest security requirements and compliances are met for government sites in the Five Eyes alliance, safeguard critical infrastructure within the utilities industry, and ensure uninterrupted movement for transport and logistics.
